html:
G'oya

"Shu datchikning oldingi o'lchovi" bu LAG ning PARTITION BY sensor_id bilan ishi. Baza o'lchovlarni datchik va vaqt bo'yicha bir marta saralaydi va har bir qatorga oldingisining qiymatini beradi.

Yechim

SELECT id, sensor_id, measured_at, value,
       value - LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY sensor_id ORDER BY measured_at, id) AS change
FROM readings

Saralashda id ham bor: vaqti teng o'lchovlarda tartibni u hal qiladi.

Tuzoqlar

Ichki so'rov bilan izlash to'g'ri natija beradi, lekin har bir o'lchov uchun shu datchikning hamma o'lchovlarini ko'radi va saralaydi. sensor_id bo'yicha indeks bu yerda kam yordam beradi: datchik to'rtta, har birida mingdan ortiq o'lchov.

SELECT r.id, r.sensor_id, r.measured_at, r.value,
       r.value - (SELECT p.value
                  FROM readings p
                  WHERE p.sensor_id = r.sensor_id
                    AND (p.measured_at < r.measured_at
                         OR (p.measured_at = r.measured_at AND p.id < r.id))
                  ORDER BY p.measured_at DESC, p.id DESC
                  LIMIT 1) AS change
FROM readings r

PARTITION BY siz LAG boshqa datchikning o'lchovini oladi: namunada 2-datchikning 08:00 dagi 55 i 1-datchikning 08:00 dagi o'lchovidan keyin keladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT id, sensor_id, measured_at, value,
       value - LAG(value) OVER (ORDER BY measured_at, id) AS change
FROM readings
